channel.title: Yaprflow Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Yaprflow for Mac.

item.description:
# Yaprflow 5.2.18
- Simplifies Meeting Notes on Mac with a grouped Library sidebar, clearer recording controls, fewer competing actions, and a separate Settings window. - Streamlines iPhone and iPad around two clear modes—Dictation and Meeting—with a persistent labeled capture control, one Library, and a two-column iPad meeting workspace. - Standardizes labels such as Notes format and Your notes across Mac and iOS. - Uses the same on-device Parakeet speech engine on Mac, iPhone, and iPad while removing unused legacy transcription runtimes and calendar integration. - Improves meeting and dictation persistence, including safer recovery from interrupted writes and more consistent local records. - Improves OpenRouter and OpenAI transcript processing when a model exhausts its response budget. Yaprflow retries with more room, then divides long transcripts into smaller parts if needed. - Avoids decrypting saved AI credentials merely to open Settings or Meeting Notes, preventing unnecessary Keychain prompts and window stalls.
Speech recognition remains on-device and raw audio is not saved. The original transcript remains unchanged. Text is sent off-device only when you choose and use an online AI provider.

# Yaprflow 5.2.17
- Improves Meeting Notes speaker separation: Mac playback is less likely to appear as duplicate “Me” speech, while distinct microphone speech remains. - Refines transcript matching for shortened or repeated system-audio echoes. - Makes the menu bar recording indicator red for both meetings and Quick Dictation, with yellow reserved for preparation or paused states. - Adds optional automatic polishing of new dictations using the selected AI provider. The original transcript and copied text remain unchanged.
Speech recognition remains on the Mac. If an online AI provider is selected for optional polishing, that provider receives the dictation text.

# Yaprflow 5.2.16
- Shrinks the live Quick Dictation audio-level overlay to 208 × 36 points, with a shorter waveform and tight spacing around the recording indicator. - Preparation and error messages resize only when they need more room. - Includes the transcription boundary improvements from 5.2.14 and the menu bar status colors from 5.2.15.
Speech recognition remains on the Mac.
